def transform(g):

    i0,i1=min(is_),max(is_); j0,j1=min(js),max(js)
    ci,cj=(i0+i1)/2,(j0+j1)/2
    mi,mj=(i0+i1+1)//2,(j0+j1+1)//2
    par={}
